## Summary

Describe the learner or repository outcome in one concise paragraph.

## Change type

- [ ] Visual roadmap or learning-flow improvement
- [ ] Curated resource or build-challenge content update
- [ ] API, database, authentication, or storage change
- [ ] Documentation, CI, or deployment-maintenance update
- [ ] Bug fix

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run quality` passes locally.
- [ ] Affected desktop and mobile state has been checked.
- [ ] Loading, error, and empty states have been considered where data changes.
- [ ] New deterministic logic has Vitest coverage.
- [ ] Migration SQL was generated, reviewed, and applied when the schema changed.
- [ ] Resource or project content includes direct source, provider, stage, and provenance labels.

## Deployment impact

State whether Vercel environment variables, migrations, or manual production endpoint verification are required. Link the matching GitHub Actions run and Vercel deployment after release.
